name: MyApp ERP
headline: From purchase order to paid invoice.
summary: A connected workspace for trading and distribution businesses. Purchase orders, delivery challans, invoices and receipts belong to one workflow, rather than separate spreadsheets.
capabilities: Purchase order import and delivery challans
Payments, permissions and FBR API integration
decision: Company access and payment visibility are checked in the API. Document import and configurable print templates connect operational work with the documents businesses actually need.
caption: Illustrative workflow · based on repository functionality
role: Personal full-stack application · API and business workflows

name: Ledger POS
headline: A checkout that connects to the back office.
summary: A retail point-of-sale workspace with registered terminals, cashier shifts, barcode checkout, split payments and sales reporting. Built for the everyday flow of a multi-company retail business in Pakistan.
decision: Sales settlement and fiscal submission are separate concerns. The gateway client treats uncertain submissions carefully instead of blindly retrying a sale that may already have been accepted.
caption: Actual application capture · browser demo with fictional PrimeMart data
role: Personal full-stack application · retail and integration workflows

name: InvoicePro
headline: Know what’s billed. Know what’s owed.
summary: Multi-company invoice management and accounts receivable for service businesses. Create branded invoices, record partial payments and follow each client’s balance through a connected ledger.
capabilities: Custom print templates, PDF and Excel reports
decision: Payment state is derived from payment records. Server-side ledger reconciliation connects invoice debits and payment credits to a running balance, keeping financial logic outside the browser.
caption: Illustrative invoice · fictional business and amounts
role: Personal full-stack application · billing and ledger workflows
